subject: math
description: Calculate deciles and percentiles from ungrouped data, use locator positions, interpolate between ordered values, and interpret results in context.
learningObjectives: Order ungrouped data before finding measures of position
Calculate deciles using the locator formula
Calculate percentiles using the locator formula
Interpolate between ordered values when a locator is not a whole number
Interpret decile and percentile values in context
prerequisites: Order numbers from least to greatest
Count data values in a set
Read positions in an ordered list
Write a short explanation using evidence
